sections.title: Custom deployment? Register OAuth redirect URLs first (one-time)
sections.excerpt: Custom deployment? Register OAuth redirect URLs first (one-time) | You only need this if your team runs a custom or self-hosted Segmently install. In that case an admin must add the OAuth callback URL in the Stripe Dashboard (Connect Settings) before the Connect button will work, because Stripe rejects an unregistered redirect URL. On the standard hosted Segmently this is already handled for you — you can skip this step.

sections.title: Connect Stripe before adding products
sections.excerpt: Connect Stripe before adding products | Click Connect to link your Stripe account here first — Segmently needs it to match each paywall product to a real Stripe product and price so payments actually go through. Stripe's Test and Live environments are separate accounts, so each needs its own connection. Start with Test mode so you can run a full checkout safely before any real money moves.
